modes.native: The surface provides its own usable interface.
modes.read-only: The surface presents authorized state and hands mutations to a canonical surface.
modes.deep-link: The surface exposes a safe entry point to the canonical interface.
modes.api: The Worker provides policy-enforcing transport or storage, not an end-user screen.
modes.device-local: The capability intentionally stays on the owner device.
modes.not-applicable: The capability would violate the surface boundary or has no meaningful UI there.
